map.%GRR<10% 测量系统可接受。: A measurement system with %GRR below 10% is acceptable.
map.%GRR = GRR / 总变异 * 100%。例：GRR=0.004、总变异: %GRR = GRR / total variation x 100%. Example: GRR=0.004, total variation 0.02 gives %GRR=20%.
map.%GRR=1.8/12×100%=15.0%，落在 10%~30% 之间属临界区: %GRR = 1.8/12 x 100% = 15.0%, which lands in the 10%-30% borderline region and is usually taken as acceptable but needing attention; improve the gage or method whenever conditions allow.
map.<10% 优，10-30% 视情况，>30% 不可接受。: Below 10% is good, 10-30% depends on the situation, above 30% is unacceptable.
map.%GRR 基于总变异，P/T 基于公差，两者并列评估。: %GRR is based on total variation and P/T on tolerance; the two are assessed side by side.
map.测量系统 %GRR：%GRR = GRR 变差 ÷ 公差带 Tol × 100（: Measurement system %GRR: %GRR = GRR variation ÷ tolerance band Tol × 100 (%); linked values: non-GRR share = 1 − %GRR/100, tolerance-to-GRR ratio = Tol ÷ max(GRR,10⁻¹²), %GRR as a decimal = %GRR/100. Validation: non-empty guards for GRR and Tol. Criteria: the page itself sets no grading; the common AIAG convention is given for reference — <10% ideal, 10–30% acceptable, >30% unacceptable.
